subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should Telegram pinned-message reads ship as an explicit gated on-demand action/command first, or should they wait for broader Telegram message-read/context-injection design?
rationale: Current main still lacks the feature, but adding it exposes durable room context to agents and requires a maintainer-approved security/default boundary.

options.title: Ship gated on-demand read first
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned read-pinned/list-pins action or command backed by getChat.pinned_message, disabled by an explicit action gate when configured, without automatic session injection.

options.title: Fold into broader Telegram read work
options.body: Keep this issue open under the wider Telegram message-read design so history and pinned-context semantics are settled together.

options.title: Defer automatic context injection
options.body: Allow no session-start ingestion until maintainers approve opt-in storage and prompt-injection behavior for pinned content.

recommendation.title: Ship gated on-demand read first
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned read-pinned/list-pins action or command backed by getChat.pinned_message, disabled by an explicit action gate when configured, without automatic session injection.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining blocker is the product/security default, and steipete is the strongest history signal for plugin-boundary policy plus prior review context.
